   144→## Code Architecture
   145→
   146→### Video Player Architecture (`working_protos/00_video_loop*`)
   147→
   148→Optimized MJPEG player variants with minimal code footprint.
   149→
   150→**Design Pattern:**
   151→- **MemoryStream class**: Minimal Stream implementation for PSRAM buffer access
   152→- **VideoPlayer class**: Encapsulates display, flash I/O, and MJPEG decoding
   153→- **Singleton pattern**: Static instance for JPEG callback access
   154→- **RAII initialization**: All setup in `begin()`, simple `play()` for loop
   155→
   156→**Variants:**
   157→- `00_video_loop/` - Base video loop
   158→- `00_video_loop_btn_pause/` - Button pause/resume
   159→- `00_video_loop_btn_pause_gyro_rotate/` - IMU-based orientation
   160→
   161→### LLM Inference Architecture (`working_protos/01_llm_inference*`)
   162→
   163→Port of llama2.c for on-device text generation.
   164→
   165→**Files:**
   166→- `llm_core.cpp/h` - Transformer forward pass, attention, RoPE
   167→- `tokenizer.cpp/h` - BPE tokenizer (SentencePiece format)
   168→- `sampler.cpp/h` - Temperature/top-p sampling
   169→- `sd_data/` - Model and tokenizer binaries for SD card
   170→
   171→**Model Specs:**
   172→- `stories15m` - 15M param TinyStories (~15MB)
   173→- `stories260k` - 260K param TinyStories (~300KB, faster)
   174→
   175→**Usage:** Load model from SD card to PSRAM, generate token-by-token.
   176→
   177→### Wake Word Detection (`tests/wakeword_pretrained_test/`)
   178→
   179→microWakeWord-based detection using EdgeNeuron TFLite runtime.
   180→
   181→**Pipeline:**
   182→1. INMP441 mic → 16kHz audio capture
   183→2. Microfrontend → 40-bin log-mel spectrogram (30ms window, 10ms stride)
   184→3. EdgeNeuron → TFLite inference every 10ms
   185→4. Sliding window → Probability averaging → Detection trigger
   186→
   187→**Configuration:** JSON config on SD card controls thresholds:
   188→```json
   189→{"probability_cutoff": 0.5, "sliding_window_average_size": 10, ...}
   190→```
   191→
   192→**Training:** See `tests/wakeword_training_ipynb_poc/` for custom wake word training via Colab.
   193→
   194→### Audio Embedding Architecture (`tests/yamnet_audio_embedding_ipynb_poc/`)
   195→
   196→YAMNet-based 1024-D audio embeddings on ESP32-S3.
   197→
   198→**Pipeline:**
   199→1. Dual INMP441 mics → stereo capture → mono downmix
   200→2. ESP-DSP accelerated FFT → 64-mel × 96-frame spectrogram
   201→3. TensorFlowLite_ESP32 → YAMNet inference (dual-core optimized)
   202→4. Extract 1024-D embedding → JSON output
   203→
   204→**Performance:** ~10-14 seconds total (inference is the bottleneck at 6-10s).
   205→
   206→### Factory Demo Architecture (`ESP32-S3-LCD-2-Demo/Arduino/examples/01_factory`)
   207→
   208→Multi-module reference implementation showing full hardware capabilities.
   209→
   210→**BSP Layer (Board Support Package):**
   211→- `bsp_spi.h/.cpp`: Shared SPI bus with semaphore protection
   212→- `bsp_i2c.h/.cpp`: I2C bus for IMU
   213→- `bsp_lv_port.h/.cpp`: LVGL display driver integration
   214→- `bsp_button.h/.cpp`: Hardware button handling
   215→
   216→**App Layer:**
   217→- `app_qmi8658`: IMU data reading and visualization
   218→- `app_system`: System monitoring (battery, brightness)
   219→- `app_camera`: Camera integration
   220→- `app_wifi`: WiFi scanning and connection
   221→
   222→**UI Layer:**
   223→- `lvgl_ui/`: LVGL tabview UI
   224→- Each tab corresponds to an app module
   225→
   226→**Initialization Sequence:**
   227→```cpp
   228→setup() {
   229→  bsp_i2c_init();      // I2C bus
   230→  bsp_lv_port_init();  // Display + LVGL
   231→  bsp_spi_init();      // Shared SPI
   232→  bsp_button_init();   // Buttons
   233→
   234→  lvgl_ui_init();      // UI components
   235→
   236→  app_*_init();        // Module initialization
   237→  app_*_run();         // Start module tasks
   238→}
   239→```
   240→
   241→### Key Libraries
   242→
   243→**Arduino_GFX_Library:**
   244→- Hardware abstraction for ST7789 display
   245→- SPI bus configuration: `Arduino_ESP32SPI`
   246→- Display driver: `Arduino_ST7789` (240x320, IPS mode)
   247→
   248→**LVGL (Light and Versatile Graphics Library):**
   249→- Must configure `lv_conf.h` before use
   250→- Factory example uses LVGL 8.x API
   251→- Thread safety via `lvgl_lock()`/`lvgl_unlock()`
   252→
   253→**JPEGDEC:**
   254→- Software JPEG decoder
   255→- Used by MjpegClass for frame-by-frame decoding
   256→- Callback-based rendering: `JPEG_DRAW_CALLBACK`
   257→
   258→**MjpegClass:**
   259→- Custom MJPEG container parser (not a library)
   260→- Searches for JPEG markers (0xFFD8/0xFFD9) in stream
   261→- Extracts individual frames for JPEGDEC

   263→## FFat Partition Layout
   264→
   265→From `app3M_fat9M_16MB.csv`:
   266→```
   267→# Name,   Type, SubType, Offset,  Size
   268→nvs,      data, nvs,     0x9000,  0x5000
   269→otadata,  data, ota,     0xe000,  0x2000
   270→app0,     app,  ota_0,   0x10000, 0x300000
   271→app1,     app,  ota_1,   0x310000,0x300000
   272→ffat,     data, fat,     0x610000,0x9E0000
   273→```
   274→
   275→**Important:** Flash FFat images at offset **0x611000** (+0x1000 from partition start)
   276→
   277→## PSRAM Usage
   278→
   279→**Enabled via Arduino IDE settings:** OPI PSRAM
   280→
   281→**Allocation:**
   282→```cpp
   283→uint8_t* buffer = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(size);  // PSRAM
   284→uint8_t* buffer = (uint8_t*)malloc(size);     // Heap
   285→```
   286→
   287→**Best Practice:**
   288→- Large buffers (>100KB): Use PSRAM
   289→- Frame buffers, video data: PSRAM
   290→- Small work buffers: Heap
   291→
   292→## Common Patterns
   293→
   294→### Dual I2S Audio Architecture
   295→
   296→ESP32-S3 supports separate I2S buses for simultaneous input/output:
   297→
   298→```cpp
   299→// I2S0 for microphones (RX)
   300→i2s_config_t mic_config = {
   301→  .mode = I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_RX,
   302→  .sample_rate = 16000,
   303→  .bits_per_sample = I2S_BITS_PER_SAMPLE_32BIT,  // INMP441 sends 24-bit in 32-bit frame
   304→  .channel_format = I2S_CHANNEL_FMT_RIGHT_LEFT,
   305→  // ...
   306→};
   307→i2s_driver_install(I2S_NUM_0, &mic_config, 0, NULL);
   308→
   309→// I2S1 for speaker (TX)
   310→i2s_config_t spk_config = {
   311→  .mode = I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_TX,
   312→  .sample_rate = 16000,
   313→  .bits_per_sample = I2S_BITS_PER_SAMPLE_16BIT,
   314→  // ...
   315→};
   316→i2s_driver_install(I2S_NUM_1, &spk_config, 0, NULL);
   317→```
   318→
   319→See `workbench/working_protos/02_speaker_mic_combo/` for full duplex example.
   320→
   321→### SPI Bus Sharing
   322→
   323→Multiple devices (LCD, SD card) share SPI bus - must use semaphore:
   324→
   325→```cpp
   326→if (bsp_spi_lock(-1)) {
   327→  // SPI operations
   328→  bsp_spi_unlock();
   329→}
   330→```
   331→
   332→### LVGL Thread Safety
   333→
   334→All LVGL calls must be protected:
   335→
   336→```cpp
   337→if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   338→  // LVGL UI updates
   339→  lvgl_unlock();
   340→}
   341→```
   342→
   343→### Stream-based File I/O
   344→
   345→Prefer Stream abstraction for memory/file interchangeability:
   346→
   347→```cpp
   348→class MemoryStream : public Stream {
   349→  // Implement available(), read(), peek(), readBytes()
   350→};
   351→```
   352→
   353→## Optimization Philosophy
   354→
   355→The `video_loop` prototype demonstrates aggressive optimization:
   356→
   357→**Removed:**
   358→- All Serial.print() debug output
   359→- Verbose error screens
   360→- Statistics tracking
   361→- Redundant comments and temporary variables
   362→
   363→**Retained:**
   364→- All functionality
   365→- Error detection (via return values)
   366→- Minimal LED feedback for critical failures
   367→
   368→**Result:** 59% code reduction (250→103 lines) with zero performance impact
   369→
   370→When modifying code, prioritize:
   371→1. Encapsulation over globals
   372→2. Classes over procedural code
   373→3. Minimal interfaces (begin/run pattern)
   374→4. Fail-fast error handling
   375→5. Production code = no debug spam
   376→
   377→## GPIO Pin Availability
   378→
   379→Based on ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-2 schematic **PinOut** section:
   380→
   381→**Pins broken out to headers:**
   382→- IO2, IO4, IO6-18, IO21, IO43, IO44, IO47, IO48
   383→
   384→**Truly free pins** (no peripherals attached):
   385→- **GPIO 18** - Completely free
   386→- **GPIO 2, 4, 6-17, 21** - Camera pins (safe if camera not attached)
   387→
   388→**Occupied pins:**
   389→- GPIO 0 (BOOT), 1 (BL), 5 (BAT) - System
   390→- GPIO 19, 20 - USB D-, D+ (**not available**)
   391→- GPIO 33-37 - **NOT broken out** to headers
   392→- GPIO 38-42, 45 - SPI (LCD/SD card)
   393→- GPIO 43, 44 - Serial console (U0_TXD/RXD)
   394→- GPIO 46 - Touch panel interrupt
   395→- GPIO 47, 48 - I2C (IMU and touch panel)
   396→
   397→## Audio Hardware
   398→
   399→### Microphone (INMP441)
   400→- **Pins:** GPIO 2 (BCK), 4 (WS), 18 (DIN)
   401→- **I2S Port:** I2S_NUM_0 (RX mode)
   402→- **Config:** Stereo capable, 24-bit samples, 16kHz sample rate
   403→- **Test sketch:** `workbench/mic_pin_test/` or `workbench/single_mic_test/`
   404→
   405→### Speaker (MAX98357A)
   406→- **Pins:** GPIO 6 (BCLK), 7 (LRC), 8 (DIN)
   407→- **I2S Port:** I2S_NUM_1 (TX mode)
   408→- **Power:** 5V recommended for full power (3-5W capable)
   409→- **Config:** 16-bit samples, 44.1kHz sample rate, mono/stereo
   410→- **Test sketch:** `workbench/tests/speaker_beep_test/`
   411→- **Note:** GAIN pin controls volume (Float=9dB, GND=12dB, VDD=15dB)
   412→
   413→## ML Model Deployment
   414→
   415→### SD Card Layout for Models
   416→```
   417→SD:/
   418→├── models/
   419→│   ├── hey_daisy.tflite     # Wake word model (~130KB)
   420→│   └── hey_daisy.json       # Detection config
   421→├── yamnet.tflite            # Audio embedding model (167KB-4MB)

   426→### TensorFlow Lite Libraries
   427→- **EdgeNeuron**: Lightweight, good for small streaming models (wake word)
   428→- **TensorFlowLite_ESP32**: Full-featured, needed for larger models (YAMNet)
   429→
   430→### Colab Training Pipelines
   431→- `audio_semantic_xtts_ipynb/` - Audio semantic embeddings with XTTS-v2
   432→- `llm_qa_scaled_training/` - LLM Q&A fine-tuning with phases
   433→- `wakeword_training_ipynb_poc/` - Custom wake word training

   435→## OAISYS Badge Implementation Phases
   436→
   437→The unified `oaisys_badge` firmware is built in 8 phases. See `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_TODO.md` for current progress.
   438→
   439→| Phase | Description | Key Files |
   440→|-------|-------------|-----------|
   441→| 1 | Core (Video + Button + Text) | `video_player.cpp`, `orientation.cpp` |
   442→| 2 | Wake Word + Recording | `wake_word.cpp`, `audio_recorder.cpp` |
   443→| 3 | Embedding + Similarity | `yamnet_embed.cpp`, `embed_search.cpp` |
   444→| 4 | LLM Integration | `llm_core.cpp`, `tokenizer.cpp` |
   445→| 5 | Robotic TTS (SAM) | `robot_tts.cpp` |
   446→| 6 | Deep Sleep + Wake | `sleep_manager.cpp` |
   447→| 7 | WiFi + Model Updates | `wifi_manager.cpp`, `model_updater.cpp` |
   448→| 8 | Stash Upload | `stash_manager.cpp`, `data_uploader.cpp` |
   449→| Backend | FastAPI + Redis | `main.py`, `workers.py` |
   450→
   451→### State Machine Flow
   452→```
   453→BOOT → LOGO_LOOP ←→ DEEP_SLEEP (5min idle)
   454→         ↓ (button/wake word)
   455→      RECORDING (3-5 sec)
   456→         ↓
   457→      EMBEDDING → SIMILARITY
   458→         ↓
   459→   score ≥ 0.7 → LLM_INFERENCE → DISPLAY → TTS → LOGO_LOOP
   460→   score < 0.7 → TTS_SORRY → STASH_DATA → LOGO_LOOP
   461→```
   462→
   463→### Memory Management
   464→- Only ONE ML model loaded at a time
   465→- 6MB memory pool in PSRAM for model swapping
   466→- Load/unload via `begin()`/`end()` pattern
   467→
   468→### Working Methodology
   469→1. Check `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_TODO.md` for current phase
   470→2. Reference original prototypes in `working_protos/0X_*` for implementation patterns
   471→3. Update TODO tracker after completing each task
   472→4. Test each phase before moving to next

   135→### 1.3 Memory Management Strategy
   136→
   137→**Problem**: PSRAM is ~8MB, but models compete for space:
   138→- Wake word: ~700KB
   139→- YAMNet + projection: ~1MB
   140→- LLM: ~6MB
   141→- Video buffer: ~2MB
   142→
   143→**Solution**: Sequential model loading with explicit unload
   144→
   145→```cpp
   146→// Memory pool reserved in PSRAM
   147→#define ML_POOL_SIZE (6 * 1024 * 1024)  // 6MB for largest model
   148→static uint8_t* ml_pool = nullptr;
   149→
   150→// Each ML module uses pool, not direct ps_malloc
   151→class MLModule {
   152→public:
   153→    virtual bool load(uint8_t* pool, size_t pool_size) = 0;
   154→    virtual void unload() = 0;
   155→    virtual size_t requiredMemory() = 0;
   156→};
   157→
   158→// State transitions trigger load/unload:
   159→// LOGO_LOOP: wake_word.load()
   160→// RECORDING: wake_word.unload()
   161→// EMBEDDING: yamnet.load() → yamnet.unload()
   162→// LLM_INFER: llm.load() → llm.unload()
   163→// Return to LOGO_LOOP: wake_word.load()
   164→```
   165→
   166→### 1.4 Module Interfaces
   167→
   168→Each module follows `begin()`/`end()` pattern:
   169→
   170→```cpp
   171→// video_player.h
   172→class VideoPlayer {
   173→public:
   174→    bool begin(const char* mjpeg_path);  // Load video to PSRAM

   183→
   184→// wake_word.h
   185→class WakeWordDetector {
   186→public:

   188→    bool detect();       // Returns true on wake word
   189→    void end();          // Free all memory
   190→};
   191→
   192→// yamnet_embed.h
   193→class YamnetEmbedder {
   194→public:

   196→    bool extract(int16_t* audio, size_t samples, float* embedding_out);
   197→    void end();
   198→};
   199→
   200→// llm_core.h (already exists, minor adaptations)
   201→class LLMInference {
   202→public:

   204→    void generate(const char* prompt, void (*on_token)(const char*));

   207→
   208→// robot_tts.h

   344→### 2.1 Architecture

   349→│  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────┐  │
   350→│  │   FastAPI   │  │    Redis    │  │   File Storage     │  │

   510→### 4.1 Text Overlay on Video (LVGL)

   512→**Chosen: LVGL Overlay** - Rich typography, word wrap, polished look

   514→```cpp
   515→// text_overlay.cpp
   516→#include <lvgl.h>
   517→
   518→static lv_obj_t* text_layer = nullptr;
   519→static lv_obj_t* label = nullptr;
   520→
   521→void initTextOverlay() {
   522→    // Create semi-transparent container
   523→    text_layer = lv_obj_create(lv_scr_act());
   524→    lv_obj_set_size(text_layer, 230, 120);
   525→    lv_obj_align(text_layer, LV_ALIGN_BOTTOM_MID, 0, -10);
   526→    lv_obj_set_style_bg_opa(text_layer, LV_OPA_80, 0);
   527→    lv_obj_set_style_bg_color(text_layer, lv_color_hex(0x001100), 0);
   528→    lv_obj_set_style_border_width(text_layer, 2, 0);
   529→    lv_obj_set_style_border_color(text_layer, lv_color_hex(0x00FF00), 0);
   530→    lv_obj_set_style_radius(text_layer, 8, 0);
   531→
   532→    // Create label with retro monospace font
   533→    label = lv_label_create(text_layer);
   534→    lv_label_set_long_mode(label, LV_LABEL_LONG_WRAP);
   535→    lv_obj_set_width(label, 210);
   536→    lv_obj_set_style_text_color(label, lv_color_hex(0x00FF00), 0);  // Matrix green
   537→    lv_obj_set_style_text_font(label, &lv_font_montserrat_14, 0);
   538→    lv_obj_center(label);
   539→
   540→    // Initially hidden
   541→    lv_obj_add_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
   542→}
   543→
   544→void showText(const char* text) {
   545→    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   546→        lv_label_set_text(label, text);
   547→        lv_obj_clear_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
   548→        lvgl_unlock();
   549→    }
   550→}
   551→
   552→void hideText() {
   553→    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   554→        lv_obj_add_flag(text_layer, LV_OBJ_FLAG_HIDDEN);
   555→        lvgl_unlock();
   556→    }
   557→}
   558→
   559→// For streaming LLM output character-by-character
   560→void appendText(const char* chunk) {
   561→    if (lvgl_lock(-1)) {
   562→        const char* current = lv_label_get_text(label);
   563→        String updated = String(current) + chunk;
   564→        lv_label_set_text(label, updated.c_str());
   565→        lvgl_unlock();
   566→    }
   567→}
   568→```

   570→### 4.2 Wake Word → Recording Transition
   571→
   572→```cpp
   573→void transitionToRecording() {
   574→    // 1. Stop wake word detection
   575→    wakeWord.end();  // Frees ~700KB PSRAM
   576→
   577→    // 2. Reconfigure I2S for recording (same pins, different buffer size)
   578→    recorder.begin(RECORD_DURATION_MS);
   579→
   580→    // 3. Visual feedback
   581→    video.showText("Listening...");
   582→
   583→    // 4. Record
   584→    int16_t* audio = recorder.record();  // Blocking, returns PSRAM buffer
   585→    size_t samples = recorder.getSampleCount();
   586→
   587→    // 5. Save to SD
   588→    saveAudioToSD(audio, samples);
   589→
   590→    // 6. Transition to embedding
   591→    transitionToEmbedding(audio, samples);
   592→}
   593→```
   594→
   595→### 4.3 Cosine Similarity Search
   596→
   597→```cpp
   598→// embed_search.cpp
   599→class EmbeddingSearch {
   600→    float* embeddings;      // 300 × 256 floats from SD
   601→    char** intents;         // 300 strings from SD
   602→    int count;
   603→
   604→public:
   605→    bool begin(const char* embed_path, const char* intent_path) {
   606→        // Load embeddings.bin (307KB) to PSRAM
   607→        embeddings = (float*)ps_malloc(300 * 256 * sizeof(float));
   608→        File f = SD.open(embed_path);
   609→        f.read((uint8_t*)embeddings, 300 * 256 * sizeof(float));
   610→
   611→        // Load intents.txt (one per line)
   612→        // ...
   613→    }
   614→
   615→    SearchResult search(float* query_embed) {
   616→        float best_score = -1;
   617→        int best_idx = -1;
   618→
   619→        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   620→            float score = cosineSimilarity(query_embed, &embeddings[i * 256], 256);
   621→            if (score > best_score) {
   622→                best_score = score;
   623→                best_idx = i;
   624→            }
   625→        }
   626→
   627→        return {intents[best_idx], best_score};
   628→    }
   629→
   630→private:
   631→    float cosineSimilarity(float* a, float* b, int len) {
   632→        float dot = 0, norm_a = 0, norm_b = 0;
   633→        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
   634→            dot += a[i] * b[i];
   635→            norm_a += a[i] * a[i];
   636→            norm_b += b[i] * b[i];
   637→        }
   638→        return dot / (sqrtf(norm_a) * sqrtf(norm_b));
   639→    }
   640→};
   641→```
   642→
   643→### 4.4 Robotic TTS with SAM (Software Automatic Mouth)
   644→
   645→**Chosen: SAM** - Any text input, classic 1980s computer voice
   646→
   647→SAM is the legendary Commodore 64 / Apple II speech synthesizer. It converts
   648→arbitrary English text to phonemes and synthesizes robotic speech. Perfect for
   649→that retro "talking computer" vibe!
   650→
   651→```cpp
   652→// robot_tts.cpp
   653→// Using ESP32-SAM port: https://github.com/pschatzmann/ESP32-SAM
   654→
   655→#include "ESP32SAM.h"
   656→#include "AudioOutputI2S.h"
   657→
   658→class RobotTTS {
   659→private:
   660→    AudioOutputI2S* out = nullptr;
   661→    ESP32SAM* sam = nullptr;
   662→
   663→public:
   664→    bool begin() {
   665→        // Configure I2S for MAX98357A speaker
   666→        out = new AudioOutputI2S();
   667→        out->SetPinout(6, 7, 8);  // BCLK, LRC, DOUT
   668→        out->SetGain(0.5);        // Volume control
   669→        out->begin();
   670→
   671→        sam = new ESP32SAM();
   672→        return true;
   673→    }
   674→
   675→    void speak(const char* text) {
   676→        // SAM handles text-to-phoneme conversion internally
   677→        // Output: 22050Hz mono audio
   678→        sam->Say(out, text);
   679→    }
   680→
   681→    // For more robotic effect, adjust voice parameters
   682→    void setRoboticVoice() {
   683→        sam->SetSpeed(72);      // Default 72, lower = slower
   684→        sam->SetPitch(64);      // Default 64, higher = squeakier
   685→        sam->SetThroat(128);    // Default 128, affects resonance
   686→        sam->SetMouth(128);     // Default 128, affects articulation
   687→    }
   688→
   689→    // Ultra robotic: pitch down, slow, mechanical
   690→    void setUltraRobotic() {
   691→        sam->SetSpeed(50);      // Slow and deliberate
   692→        sam->SetPitch(40);      // Deep, mechanical
   693→        sam->SetThroat(160);    // More robotic resonance
   694→        sam->SetMouth(100);     // Slightly muffled
   695→    }
   696→
   697→    void end() {
   698→        if (sam) { delete sam; sam = nullptr; }
   699→        if (out) { delete out; out = nullptr; }
   700→    }
   701→};
   702→
   703→// Usage in main sketch:
   704→RobotTTS tts;
   705→
   706→void setup() {
   707→    tts.begin();
   708→    tts.setUltraRobotic();  // Maximum robot vibes!
   709→}
   710→
   711→void speakResponse(const char* text) {
   712→    video.showText(text);      // Show on screen
   713→    tts.speak(text);           // Speak robotically
   714→    delay(2000);               // Pause after speaking
   715→    video.hideText();          // Resume logo
   716→}
   717→```
   718→
   719→**Memory footprint**: ~50KB ROM for SAM phoneme tables
   720→**Latency**: Near-instant start (no model loading)
   721→**Quality**: Authentic 1980s computer voice - perfect for badge aesthetic!
   722→
   723→### 4.5 Deep Sleep with Accelerometer Wake
   724→
   725→```cpp
   726→// sleep_manager.cpp
   727→#include "esp_sleep.h"
   728→#include "driver/rtc_io.h"
   729→
   730→#define ACCEL_INT_PIN GPIO_NUM_XX  // QMI8658 INT pin (check schematic)
   731→
   732→void enterDeepSleep() {
   733→    // Save state to RTC memory
   734→    RTC_DATA_ATTR static uint8_t last_rotation;
   735→    last_rotation = video.getRotation();
   736→
   737→    // Configure QMI8658 motion interrupt
   738→    // (Set high-g threshold, enable interrupt output)
   739→    configureAccelInterrupt();
   740→
   741→    // Configure wake source
   742→    esp_sleep_enable_ext0_wakeup(ACCEL_INT_PIN, 1);  // Wake on HIGH
   743→
   744→    // Enter deep sleep
   745→    esp_deep_sleep_start();
   746→}
   747→
   748→void setup() {
   749→    if (esp_sleep_get_wakeup_cause() == ESP_SLEEP_WAKEUP_EXT0) {
   750→        // Woke from shake - restore state
   751→        video.setRotation(last_rotation);
   752→    }
   753→    // Normal boot...
   754→}
   755→```
   756→
   757→---
   758→
   759→## Part 5: Testing Checkpoints
   760→
   761→| Phase | Test | Pass Criteria |
   762→|-------|------|---------------|
   763→| 1 | Logo plays | MJPEG loops smoothly at 30+ FPS |
   764→| 1 | Text overlay | Text appears over video |
   765→| 1 | Gyro rotation | Tilting rotates display |
   766→| 2 | Wake word | "Hey Daisy" triggers within 2 sec |
   767→| 2 | Recording | 5 sec audio saved to SD as WAV |
   768→| 3 | Embedding | YAMNet produces 256-dim vector |
   769→| 3 | Similarity | Correct intent found for test phrase |
   770→| 4 | LLM load | Model loads in <5 sec |
   771→| 4 | Generation | Response streams to display |
   772→| 5 | TTS output | Robotic speech audible from speaker |
   773→| 6 | Deep sleep | Current drops to <10mA |
   774→| 6 | Shake wake | Badge wakes and resumes logo |
   775→| 7 | WiFi connect | Connects from SD config |
   776→| 7 | Model check | Detects new version on server |
   777→| 8 | Stash upload | 10 files uploaded successfully |
   778→| Backend | Manifest | GET returns model versions |
   779→| Backend | Transcribe | Uploaded audio gets transcript |
   780→| Backend | Correction | UI allows editing and saving |
   781→
   782→---
   783→
   784→## Part 6: Risk Mitigation
   785→
   786→| Risk | Mitigation |
   787→|------|------------|
   788→| PSRAM fragmentation | Use fixed memory pool, sequential load/unload |
   789→| Wake word false positives | Tune threshold in config.json, add cooldown |
   790→| Embedding mismatch | Start with high threshold (0.8), tune down |
   791→| LLM hallucination | Train on exact Q&A, use low temperature |
   792→| TTS unintelligible | Test Talkie vs SAM, choose clearer one |
   793→| WiFi unreliable | Graceful degradation, work fully offline |
   794→| Deep sleep instability | Test thoroughly, add watchdog timer |
   795→| SD card corruption | Use safe write patterns, checksums |
   796→
   797→---
   798→
   799→## Implementation Order (Sequential)
   800→
   801→**Chosen approach**: Complete each phase before starting next - safer, easier to debug
   802→
   803→```
   804→Week 1: Foundation
   805→├── Phase 1: Core (Video + State Machine)              ████████░░  2-3 days
   806→│   └── Checkpoint: Logo plays, gyro rotates, text overlay works
   807→│
   808→└── Phase 2: Wake Word + Recording                     ████████░░  2 days
   809→    └── Checkpoint: "Hey Daisy" triggers, 5 sec recorded to SD
   810→
   811→Week 2: ML Pipeline
   812→├── Phase 3: Embedding Extraction                      ████████░░  2-3 days
   813→│   └── Checkpoint: Audio → 256-dim embedding → similarity search
   814→│
   815→└── Phase 4: LLM Integration                           ████░░░░░░  1-2 days
   816→    └── Checkpoint: Matched intent → LLM generates → displays text
   817→
   818→Week 3: Audio + Power
   819→├── Phase 5: Robotic TTS (SAM)                         ████████░░  2-3 days
   820→│   └── Checkpoint: Badge speaks responses in robotic voice
   821→│
   822→└── Phase 6: Deep Sleep + Wake                         ████░░░░░░  1-2 days
   823→    └── Checkpoint: 5min idle → sleep → shake → wake
   824→
   825→Week 4: Network + Backend
   826→├── Phase 7: WiFi + Model Updates                      ████████░░  2 days
   827→│   └── Checkpoint: Downloads new model from server
   828→│
   829→├── Phase 8: Stash Upload                              ████░░░░░░  1-2 days
   830→│   └── Checkpoint: Uploads 10 unrecognized audio files
   831→│
   832→└── Backend: FastAPI + Redis + Correction UI           ████████████  3-4 days
   833→    └── Checkpoint: Full cloud pipeline working
   834→```
   835→
   836→**Total: ~4 weeks** sequential implementation

     1→# OAISYS25 Badge Firmware
     2→
     3→Unified firmware integrating all badge functionality.
     4→
     5→> **Plan:** `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_PLAN.md`
     6→> **Progress:** `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_TODO.md`
     7→
     8→## Phase 2: Wake Word + Recording (Current)
     9→- Video loop playback (MJPEG from SD card)
    10→- Gyro-based screen rotation
    11→- Wake word detection ("Hey Daisy")
    12→- Audio recording after wake word trigger
    13→
    14→## Hardware
    15→- ESP32-S3-LCD-2 (Waveshare)
    16→- ST7789 240x320 LCD
    17→- QMI8658 IMU
    18→- INMP441 Mics (x2)
    19→- MAX98357A Speaker
    20→- SD Card (for media, models, config)
    21→
    22→## Building
    23→1. Open `oaisys_badge.ino` in Arduino IDE 2.x
    24→2. Select Board: ESP32S3 Dev Module
    25→3. Settings:
    26→   - Flash: 16MB
    27→   - Partition: 16MB Flash (3MB APP/9MB FATFS)
    28→   - PSRAM: OPI PSRAM
    29→4. Upload sketch
    30→5. Copy `sd_data/*` contents to SD card root
    31→
    32→## Controls (Phase 2)
    33→- **Wake word**: Say "Hey Daisy" to start recording
    34→- Recording shows RED screen, completion shows GREEN
    35→- Auto-returns to video loop after 2 seconds
    36→
    37→## Directory Structure
    38→```
    39→oaisys_badge/
    40→├── oaisys_badge.ino    # Main sketch
    41→├── config.h            # Pin definitions
    42→├── src/                # Source files (Arduino compiles recursively)
    43→│   ├── display/
    44→│   │   └── video_player.*  # Video + text overlay
    45→│   ├── sensors/
    46→│   │   └── orientation.*   # IMU rotation
    47→│   ├── audio/              # (Phase 2)
    48→│   ├── ml/                 # (Phase 3-4)
    49→│   ├── tts/                # (Phase 5)

    84→
    85→**Arduino Sketch Rule:** `.ino` file MUST be in folder with same name (e.g., `my_sketch/my_sketch.ino`)
    86→
    87→## Code Architecture
    88→
    89→### State Machine (`local_llm_badge/local_llm_badge.ino`)
    90→
    91→The main firmware implements this flow:
    92→```
    93→BOOT → LOGO_LOOP ←→ DEEP_SLEEP (5min idle)
    94→         ↓ (wake word: "Hey Daisy")
    95→      RECORDING (3-5 sec, RED screen)
    96→         ↓
    97→      EMBEDDING → SIMILARITY
    98→         ↓
    99→   score ≥ 0.7 → LLM_INFERENCE → DISPLAY → TTS → LOGO_LOOP
   100→   score < 0.7 → TTS_SORRY → STASH_DATA → LOGO_LOOP
   101→```
   102→
   103→### Module Pattern
   104→
   105→All modules follow `begin()`/`end()` with memory pool for sequential model loading:
   106→```cpp
   107→class MLModule {
   108→    bool begin(uint8_t* pool, size_t size);  // Load to shared 6MB pool
   109→    void end();                               // Free for next model
   110→};
   111→```
   112→
   113→### Key Implementations
   114→
   115→| Component | Location | Pattern |
   116→|-----------|----------|---------|
   117→| Video Player | `src/display/video_player.*` | MemoryStream + JPEGDEC callback |
   118→| Wake Word | `src/ml/wake_word.*` | EdgeNeuron + sliding window |
   119→| Audio Embed | `src/ml/audio_embed.*` | ESP-DSP FFT + TFLite CNN |
   120→| LLM | `src/ml/llm_core.*` | llama2.c port, Q8_0 quantized |
   121→| TTS | `src/tts/robot_tts.*` | ESP32-SAM at 22050Hz |
   122→| Orientation | `src/sensors/orientation.*` | QMI8658 via FastIMU |
   123→
   124→### Reference Prototypes
   125→
   126→Working examples in `workbench/working_protos/`:
   127→- `00_video_loop*` - MJPEG playback variants
   128→- `01_llm_inference*` - LLM text generation
   129→- `02_speaker_mic_combo` - Dual I2S audio
   130→- `03_custom_wakeword` - Wake word detection
   131→- `04_yamnet_audio_embedding` - Audio embeddings
   132→- `05_llm_finetuned` - Fine-tuned Q8_0 LLM
   133→
   134→## Memory & Partitions
   135→
   136→### PSRAM Budget (~8MB)
   137→- Video buffer: ~2MB
   138→- ML Pool: 6MB (shared, one model at a time)
   139→- Embedding DB: ~300KB
   140→
   141→### FFat Partition (16MB Flash)
   142→```
   143→Offset     Size       Name
   144→0x610000   0x9E0000   ffat (9.9MB)
   145→```
   146→**Flash at 0x611000** (+0x1000 from partition start)
   147→
   148→## Common Patterns
   149→
   150→### Dual I2S Audio
   151→```cpp
   152→// I2S0: Microphones (RX), 16kHz, 32-bit (INMP441 sends 24-bit in 32-bit frame)
   153→// I2S1: Speaker (TX), 22050Hz for SAM TTS
   154→```
   155→
   156→### SPI Bus Sharing (LCD + SD)
   157→```cpp
   158→// Use semaphore when shared: bsp_spi_lock(-1) / bsp_spi_unlock()
   159→```
   160→
   161→### PSRAM Allocation
   162→```cpp
   163→ps_malloc(size);   // Large buffers (>100KB)
   164→malloc(size);      // Small work buffers
   165→```
   166→
   167→## SD Card Layout
   168→```
   169→SD:/
   170→├── config.json              # Runtime config (WiFi, thresholds)
   171→├── media/logo.mjpeg         # Boot animation
   172→├── models/
   173→│   ├── wake_word.tflite     # 130KB
   174→│   ├── audio_encoder.tflite # 100-300KB (custom CNN)
   175→│   ├── llm_model.bin        # 6MB (Q8_0)
   176→│   └── tokenizer.bin        # 13KB
   177→└── data/
   178→    ├── embeddings.bin       # 300×256 float32
   179→    └── intents.txt          # Intent strings
   180→```
   181→
   182→## Implementation Progress
   183→
   184→See `workbench/docs/OAISYS_BADGE_TODO.md` for current status.
   185→
   186→| Phase | Status |
   187→|-------|--------|
   188→| 1: Video + Gyro | COMPLETE |
   189→| 2: Wake Word | COMPLETE |
   190→| 3: Embedding | IN PROGRESS (training) |
   191→| 4: LLM | COMPLETE |
   192→| 5: TTS (SAM) | COMPLETE |
   193→| 6-8: Sleep/WiFi/Stash | PENDING |
   194→
   195→## Design Principles
   196→
   197→1. **Single model in memory** - Sequential load/unload to 6MB pool
   198→2. **No debug spam** - Production builds remove Serial.print()
   199→3. **Encapsulation** - Classes with begin()/end() pattern
   200→4. **Fail-fast** - Return values, minimal error screens
   201→5. **SD-first** - Models and config on SD card, not flash
   202→

   106→void initSwitches() {
   107→    // Configure output pins (always LOW)

   109→    digitalWrite(BTN1_OUT, LOW);
   110→    pinMode(BTN2_OUT, OUTPUT);

   117→
   118→bool isBTN1Bridged() {
   119→    // Returns true when switch is bridged (input pulled LOW by output)
   120→    return digitalRead(BTN1_IN) == LOW;
   121→}
   122→
   123→bool isBTN2Bridged() {
   124→    // Returns true when switch is bridged (input pulled LOW by output)

   128→void enterDeepSleep() {

   192→//==============================================================================
   193→// State Machine Helpers
   194→//==============================================================================
   195→
   196→void setState(BadgeState newState) {
   197→    if (currentState == newState) return;
   198→
   199→    Serial.printf("State: %d -> %d\n", currentState, newState);
   200→
   201→    // Exit current state
   202→    switch (currentState) {
   203→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   204→            // Stop wake word detection and mic stream
   205→            if (wakeWordActive) {
   206→                wakeWord.end();
   207→                micStream.end();
   208→                wakeWordActive = false;
   209→            }
   210→            break;
   211→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   212→            video.hideText();
   213→            break;
   214→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   215→            recorder.stopRecording();
   216→            break;
   217→        default:
   218→            break;
   219→    }
   220→
   221→    currentState = newState;
   222→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   223→
   224→    // Enter new state
   225→    switch (newState) {
   226→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   227→            video.resume();
   228→            // Start wake word detection (unless voice disabled by BTN1)
   229→            if (!voiceDisabled && mlPool) {
   230→                if (micStream.begin()) {
   231→                    if (wakeWord.begin(mlPool, ML_POOL_SIZE, WAKE_MODEL_PATH, WAKE_CONFIG_PATH)) {
   232→                        wakeWordActive = true;
   233→                        Serial.printf("Listening for \"%s\"...\n", wakeWord.getWakeWord());
   234→                        // Refresh display after SD card access (wake word model loading)
   235→                        video.refreshDisplay();
   236→                    } else {
   237→                        Serial.println("Wake word init failed");
   238→                        micStream.end();
   239→                    }
   240→                } else {
   241→                    Serial.println("Mic stream init failed");
   242→                }
   243→            } else if (voiceDisabled) {
   244→                Serial.println("Voice disabled - logo loop only");
   245→            }
   246→            break;
   247→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   248→            // Pause video during recording
   249→            video.pause();
   250→            recorder.startRecording(runtimeConfig.recordDurationMs / 1000.0f);
   251→            break;
   252→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   253→            // Keep logo playing - response already spoken via TTS
   254→            video.resume();
   255→            video.hideText();
   256→            break;
   257→        case STATE_EMBEDDING:
   258→            // Keep video paused during processing (no text - looks cleaner)
   259→            video.pause();
   260→            video.hideText();
   261→            printPSRAM("before audio encoder");
   262→            // Load audio encoder model
   263→            if (!audioEmbed.begin(mlPool, ML_POOL_SIZE, AUDIO_ENCODER_PATH)) {
   264→                Serial.println("Audio encoder init failed - returning to logo");
   265→                setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   266→            } else {
   267→                printPSRAM("after audio encoder");
   268→            }
   269→            break;
   270→        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
   271→            // Audio encoder unloaded, search against embeddings
   272→            audioEmbed.end();
   273→            // Keep video paused (no text)
   274→            break;
   275→        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:
   276→            // Keep logo playing - just speak the apology, no text needed
   277→            video.resume();
   278→            video.hideText();
   279→            ttsSpeaking = true;
   280→            break;
   281→        case STATE_TTS_OUTPUT:
   282→            // Pause video to show LLM response text
   283→            video.pause();
   284→            video.refreshDisplay();
   285→            video.fillScreen(0x0000);  // BLACK background for text
   286→            if (llmResponse.length() > 0) {
   287→                video.showText(llmResponse.c_str());
   288→            }
   289→            ttsSpeaking = true;
   290→            break;
   291→        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:
   292→            // Pause video to show streaming LLM text
   293→            video.pause();
   294→            video.refreshDisplay();
   295→            video.fillScreen(0x0000);  // BLACK background for text
   296→            video.clearText();
   297→            video.showText("");  // Initialize empty text box
   298→            llmResponse = "";
   299→            llmGenerating = true;
   300→
   301→            // CRITICAL: Free everything possible to make room for LLM model (~7MB needed)
   302→            // The search result is already saved in lastSearchResult.intent
   303→            Serial.println("Freeing memory for LLM...");
   304→
   305→            // Free embeddings (~2MB)
   306→            embedSearch.end();
   307→            printPSRAM("after embed unload");
   308→
   309→            // Free ML pool (~1MB) - LLM doesn't use it
   310→            if (mlPool) {
   311→                free(mlPool);
   312→                mlPool = nullptr;
   313→                Serial.println("Freed ML pool");
   314→            }
   315→
   316→            // Free video buffer (~1.2MB) - we only need display for text
   317→            video.unloadVideo();
   318→            printPSRAM("after video unload");
   319→
   320→            // Load LLM model
   321→            Serial.println("Loading LLM model...");
   322→            if (!llmInference.begin(nullptr, 0, LLM_MODEL_PATH, TOKENIZER_PATH)) {
   323→                Serial.println("LLM init failed - showing intent only");
   324→                video.showText(lastSearchResult.intent);
   325→                llmGenerating = false;
   326→                // Reload video buffer
   327→                video.reloadVideo();
   328→                // Reload embeddings since LLM failed
   329→                embedSearch.begin(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, INTENTS_PATH);
   330→                // Reallocate ML pool
   331→                if (!mlPool) {
   332→                    mlPool = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(ML_POOL_SIZE);
   333→                }
   334→                setState(STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE);
   335→            } else {
   336→                // Apply runtime config
   337→                llmInference.setTemperature(runtimeConfig.llmTemperature);
   338→                llmInference.setTopP(runtimeConfig.llmTopP);
   339→                llmInference.setMaxTokens(runtimeConfig.llmMaxTokens);
   340→            }
   341→            break;
   342→        default:
   343→            break;
   344→    }
   345→}
   346→
   347→void resetActivityTimer() {
   348→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   349→}
   350→
   351→//==============================================================================
   352→// State Handlers
   353→//==============================================================================
   354→
   355→void handleLogoLoop() {
   356→    // Update orientation
   357→    orientation.update();
   358→    if (orientation.hasChanged()) {
   359→        video.setRotation(orientation.getRotation());
   360→    }
   361→
   362→    // Play video frame
   363→    video.play();
   364→
   365→    // Check wake word if active
   366→    if (wakeWordActive) {
   367→        if (micStream.update()) {
   368→            // New features available, run wake word detection
   369→            if (wakeWord.detect(micStream.getFeatures())) {
   370→                Serial.println(">>> WAKE WORD DETECTED! <<<");
   371→                setState(STATE_RECORDING);
   372→            }
   373→        }
   374→    }
   375→}
   376→
   377→// Counter for recording filenames
   378→static int recordingCounter = 0;
   379→
   380→void handleRecording() {
   381→    // Update recording (video paused)
   382→    if (recorder.update()) {
   383→        // Recording complete
   384→        Serial.printf("Recording done: %d samples (%.2fs)\n",
   385→                      recorder.getSampleCount(), recorder.getDurationSec());
   386→
   387→        // Save recording to SD card for debugging
   388→        char filepath[64];
   389→        snprintf(filepath, sizeof(filepath), "/recordings/rec_%04d.wav", recordingCounter++);
   390→
   391→        // Create recordings directory if needed
   392→        if (!SD.exists("/recordings")) {
   393→            SD.mkdir("/recordings");
   394→        }
   395→        recorder.saveToSD(filepath);
   396→
   397→        // Phase 3: Extract embedding from recording
   398→        setState(STATE_EMBEDDING);
   399→    }
   400→}
   401→
   402→void handleEmbedding() {
   403→    // Run audio embedding extraction (blocking operation)
   404→    if (audioEmbed.embed(recorder.getBuffer(), recorder.getSampleCount(), queryEmbedding)) {
   405→        Serial.println("Embedding extracted successfully");
   406→        setState(STATE_SIMILARITY);
   407→    } else {
   408→        Serial.println("Embedding extraction failed");
   409→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   410→    }
   411→}
   412→
   413→void handleSimilarity() {
   414→    // Search for closest embedding
   415→    lastSearchResult = embedSearch.search(queryEmbedding);
   416→
   417→    Serial.printf("Best match: %s (score: %.3f)\n",
   418→                  lastSearchResult.intent, lastSearchResult.score);
   419→
   420→    if (lastSearchResult.score >= runtimeConfig.embedThreshold) {
   421→        // Good match - run LLM inference
   422→        Serial.println("High confidence match!");
   423→        setState(STATE_LLM_INFERENCE);
   424→    } else {
   425→        // Low confidence - stash and apologize
   426→        Serial.println("Low confidence - stashing");
   427→        // TODO Phase 8: stash audio and embedding
   428→        setState(STATE_TTS_SORRY);
   429→    }
   430→}
   431→
   432→void handleLLMInference() {
   433→    if (!llmGenerating) {
   434→        // Generation done - shouldn't normally get here as we transition immediately
   435→        setState(STATE_TTS_OUTPUT);
   436→        return;
   437→    }
   438→
   439→    // Run LLM generation (blocking, but streams tokens via callback)
   440→    Serial.printf("\nLLM generating response for: %s\n", lastSearchResult.intent);
   441→    int tokensGenerated = llmInference.generate(lastSearchResult.intent, onLLMToken, nullptr);
   442→    Serial.printf("\nLLM done: %d tokens\n", tokensGenerated);
   443→
   444→    llmGenerating = false;
   445→
   446→    // Unload LLM to free memory
   447→    llmInference.end();
   448→    printPSRAM("after LLM unload");
   449→
   450→    // Reload video buffer
   451→    Serial.println("Reloading video...");
   452→    if (!video.reloadVideo()) {
   453→        Serial.println("WARNING: Failed to reload video!");
   454→    }
   455→    printPSRAM("after video reload");
   456→
   457→    // Reload embeddings now that LLM is unloaded
   458→    Serial.println("Reloading embeddings...");
   459→    if (!embedSearch.begin(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, INTENTS_PATH)) {
   460→        Serial.println("WARNING: Failed to reload embeddings!");
   461→    }
   462→    printPSRAM("after embed reload");
   463→
   464→    // Reallocate ML pool for wake word / audio embed
   465→    if (!mlPool) {
   466→        mlPool = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(ML_POOL_SIZE);
   467→        if (mlPool) {
   468→            Serial.println("ML pool reallocated");
   469→        } else {
   470→            Serial.println("WARNING: ML pool reallocation failed!");
   471→        }
   472→    }
   473→    printPSRAM("after pool realloc");
   474→
   475→    // If no tokens generated, use the intent as fallback
   476→    if (tokensGenerated == 0 && llmResponse.length() == 0) {
   477→        llmResponse = lastSearchResult.intent;
   478→    }
   479→
   480→    // Transition to TTS to speak the response
   481→    setState(STATE_TTS_OUTPUT);
   482→}
   483→
   484→void handleDisplayResponse() {
   485→    // Auto-return to logo loop after 3 seconds
   486→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 3000) {
   487→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   488→    }
   489→}
   490→
   491→void handleTtsSorry() {
   492→    if (ttsSpeaking) {
   493→        // Speak apology (blocking)
   494→        tts.speak("Sorry, I could not understand that.");
   495→        ttsSpeaking = false;
   496→        lastActivityTime = millis();
   497→    }
   498→
   499→    // Wait a bit after speaking, then return to logo
   500→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 1000) {
   501→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   502→    }
   503→}
   504→
   505→void handleTtsOutput() {
   506→    if (ttsSpeaking) {
   507→        // Speak the LLM response (blocking)
   508→        if (llmResponse.length() > 0) {
   509→            tts.speak(llmResponse.c_str());
   510→        }
   511→        ttsSpeaking = false;
   512→        lastActivityTime = millis();
   513→    }
   514→
   515→    // Wait a bit after speaking, then return to logo
   516→    if (millis() - lastActivityTime > 1000) {
   517→        setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   518→    }
   519→}
   520→
   521→//==============================================================================
   522→// Main Loop State Machine
   523→//==============================================================================
   524→
   525→void loop() {
   526→    // Check mode switches first
   527→    // BTN2: Deep sleep when bridged
   528→    if (isBTN2Bridged()) {
   529→        enterDeepSleep();
   530→        // Won't reach here - ESP will reset on wake
   531→    }
   532→
   533→    // BTN1: Voice disable - check and update flag
   534→    bool btn1State = isBTN1Bridged();
   535→    if (btn1State != voiceDisabled) {
   536→        voiceDisabled = btn1State;
   537→        if (voiceDisabled) {
   538→            Serial.println("BTN1: Voice DISABLED");
   539→            // Stop wake word if currently active
   540→            if (wakeWordActive) {
   541→                wakeWord.end();
   542→                micStream.end();
   543→                wakeWordActive = false;
   544→            }
   545→        } else {
   546→            Serial.println("BTN1: Voice ENABLED");
   547→            // Will start wake word on next LOGO_LOOP transition
   548→        }
   549→    }
   550→
   551→    // State-specific handling
   552→    switch (currentState) {
   553→        case STATE_BOOT:
   554→            // Initialization complete, transition to logo loop
   555→            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   556→            break;
   557→
   558→        case STATE_LOGO_LOOP:
   559→            handleLogoLoop();
   560→            break;
   561→
   562→        case STATE_RECORDING:
   563→            handleRecording();
   564→            break;
   565→
   566→        case STATE_DISPLAY_RESPONSE:
   567→            handleDisplayResponse();
   568→            break;
   569→
   570→        case STATE_EMBEDDING:
   571→            handleEmbedding();
   572→            break;
   573→
   574→        case STATE_SIMILARITY:
   575→            handleSimilarity();
   576→            break;
   577→
   578→        case STATE_TTS_SORRY:
   579→            handleTtsSorry();
   580→            break;
   581→
   582→        case STATE_LLM_INFERENCE:
   583→            handleLLMInference();
   584→            break;
   585→
   586→        case STATE_TTS_OUTPUT:
   587→            handleTtsOutput();
   588→            break;
   589→
   590→        // Future states (Phase 6+)
   591→        case STATE_STASH_DATA:
   592→        case STATE_DEEP_SLEEP:
   593→            // Not implemented yet - return to logo
   594→            setState(STATE_LOGO_LOOP);
   595→            break;
   596→    }
   597→}
   598→
   599→//==============================================================================
   600→// Debug Helper
   601→//==============================================================================
   602→
   603→void printPSRAM(const char* label) {
   604→    Serial.printf("PSRAM [%s]: %dKB free / %dKB total\n",
   605→                  label,
   606→                  ESP.getFreePsram() / 1024,
   607→                  ESP.getPsramSize() / 1024);
   608→}
   609→
   610→//==============================================================================
   611→// Setup
   612→//==============================================================================
   613→
   614→void setup() {
   615→    Serial.begin(115200);
   616→    delay(500);
   617→    Serial.println("\n=== OAISYS25 Badge Starting ===");
   618→    printPSRAM("boot");
   619→
   620→    // Initialize mode switches first (before any other init)
   621→    initSwitches();
   622→
   623→    // Check if BTN2 is bridged - go to deep sleep immediately
   624→    if (isBTN2Bridged()) {
   625→        Serial.println("BTN2 bridged - entering deep sleep");
   626→        enterDeepSleep();
   627→    }
   628→
   629→    // Check BTN1 for voice disable mode
   630→    voiceDisabled = isBTN1Bridged();
   631→    if (voiceDisabled) {
   632→        Serial.println("BTN1 bridged - voice detection DISABLED");
   633→    }
   634→
   635→    // Initialize orientation sensor (non-fatal if fails)
   636→    if (!orientation.begin()) {
   637→        Serial.println("IMU init failed - rotation disabled");
   638→    } else {
   639→        Serial.println("IMU: OK");
   640→    }
   641→
   642→    // Initialize video player FIRST (this also inits display and SD card)
   643→    // Must be before ML pool to avoid PSRAM fragmentation
   644→    Serial.println("Loading video...");
   645→    if (!video.begin()) {
   646→        Serial.println("ERROR: Video init failed!");
   647→        // Blink LED to indicate error
   648→        pinMode(LCD_BL, OUTPUT);
   649→        while (1) {
   650→            digitalWrite(LCD_BL, !digitalRead(LCD_BL));
   651→            delay(500);
   652→        }
   653→    }
   654→    Serial.println("Video: OK");
   655→    printPSRAM("after video");
   656→
   657→    // Load runtime configuration from SD card
   658→    loadConfig();
   659→
   660→    // Initialize audio recorder (allocates PSRAM buffer)
   661→    if (!recorder.begin()) {
   662→        Serial.println("WARNING: Audio recorder init failed!");
   663→    } else {
   664→        Serial.println("Recorder: OK");
   665→    }
   666→    printPSRAM("after recorder");
   667→
   668→    // Phase 3: Allocate query embedding buffer (16-byte aligned for ESP-DSP SIMD)
   669→    queryEmbedding = (float*)heap_caps_aligned_alloc(16,
   670→        AUDIO_EMBEDDING_DIM * sizeof(float), MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM);
   671→    if (!queryEmbedding) {
   672→        Serial.println("WARNING: Query embedding buffer alloc failed!");
   673→    } else {
   674→        Serial.println("Query buffer: OK (aligned)");
   675→    }
   676→
   677→    // Phase 3: Load embedding search database (stays in memory)
   678→    // IMPORTANT: Load embeddings BEFORE ML pool - they stay resident permanently
   679→    if (!embedSearch.begin(EMBEDDINGS_PATH, INTENTS_PATH)) {
   680→        Serial.println("WARNING: Embedding search init failed!");
   681→        Serial.println("  Make sure SD card has /data/embeddings.bin and /data/intents.txt");
   682→    } else {
   683→        Serial.printf("EmbedSearch: %d intents loaded\n", embedSearch.getCount());
   684→    }
   685→    printPSRAM("after embeddings");
   686→
   687→    // Allocate ML memory pool (after embeddings to ensure they get contiguous memory)
   688→    // Remaining PSRAM is used for ML models that load/unload dynamically
   689→    if (!initMemoryPool()) {
   690→        Serial.println("WARNING: ML features disabled (no pool)");
   691→    }
   692→    printPSRAM("after ML pool");
   693→
   694→    // Phase 5: Initialize TTS (non-fatal if fails)
   695→    if (!tts.begin()) {
   696→        Serial.println("WARNING: TTS init failed - speech disabled");
   697→    } else {
   698→        Serial.println("TTS: OK (SAM robotic voice)");
   699→        // Say hello on startup
   700→        tts.speak("Hello. I am ready.");
   701→    }
   702→
   703→    // Ready to go
   704→    lastActivityTime = millis();
   705→    currentState = STATE_BOOT;
   706→
   707→    Serial.println("\n=== Badge Ready (Phase 5) ===");
   708→    printPSRAM("final");
   709→    Serial.println("Say 'Hey Daisy' to start recording");
   710→    Serial.println("Recording -> Embedding -> Similarity -> LLM -> TTS");
   711→}

    36→    bool readMjpegBuf() {
    37→        if (_inputindex == 0) {
    38→            _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    39→            _inputindex += _buf_read;
    40→        }
    41→        _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;
    42→        int i = 0;
    43→        bool found_FFD8 = false;
    44→
    45→        while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    46→            i = 0;
    47→            while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD8)) {
    48→                if ((_read_buf[i] == 0xFF) && (_read_buf[i + 1] == 0xD8)) {
    49→                    found_FFD8 = true;
    50→                }
    51→                ++i;
    52→            }
    53→            if (found_FFD8) {
    54→                --i;
    55→            } else {
    56→                _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf, READ_BUFFER_SIZE);
    57→            }
    58→        }
    59→
    60→        uint8_t *_p = _read_buf + i;
    61→        _buf_read -= i;
    62→        bool found_FFD9 = false;
    63→
    64→        if (_buf_read > 0) {
    65→            i = 3;
    66→            while ((_buf_read > 0) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    67→                if ((_mjpeg_buf_offset > 0) && (_mjpeg_buf[_mjpeg_buf_offset - 1] == 0xFF) && (_p[0] == 0xD9)) {
    68→                    found_FFD9 = true;
    69→                } else {
    70→                    while ((i < _buf_read) && (!found_FFD9)) {
    71→                        if ((_p[i] == 0xFF) && (_p[i + 1] == 0xD9)) {
    72→                            found_FFD9 = true;
    73→                            ++i;
    74→                        }
    75→                        ++i;
    76→                    }
    77→                }
    78→
    79→                memcpy(_mjpeg_buf + _mjpeg_buf_offset, _p, i);
    80→                _mjpeg_buf_offset += i;
    81→                size_t o = _buf_read - i;
    82→
    83→                if (o > 0) {
    84→                    memcpy(_read_buf, _p + i, o);
    85→                    _buf_read = _input->readBytes(_read_buf + o, READ_BUFFER_SIZE - o);
    86→                    _p = _read_buf;
    87→                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
    88→                    _buf_read += o;

    91→                    _p = _read_buf;
    92→                    _inputindex += _buf_read;
    93→                }
    94→                i = 0;
    95→            }
    96→            return found_FFD9;
    97→        }

   101→    bool drawJpg() {
   102→        _remain = _mjpeg_buf_offset;
   103→
   104→        if (_jpeg.openRAM(_mjpeg_buf, _remain, _pfnDraw) != 1) return false;
   105→
   106→        if (_scale == -1) {
   107→            int iMaxMCUs;
   108→            int w = _jpeg.getWidth();
   109→            int h = _jpeg.getHeight();
   110→            float ratio = (float)h / _heightLimit;
   111→
   112→            if (ratio <= 1) {
   113→                _scale = 0;
   114→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 16;
   115→            } else if (ratio <= 2) {
   116→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_HALF;
   117→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 8;
   118→                w /= 2;
   119→                h /= 2;
   120→            } else if (ratio <= 4) {
   121→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_QUARTER;
   122→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 4;
   123→                w /= 4;
   124→                h /= 4;
   125→            } else {
   126→                _scale = JPEG_SCALE_EIGHTH;
   127→                iMaxMCUs = _widthLimit / 2;
   128→                w /= 8;
   129→                h /= 8;
   130→            }
   131→
   132→            _jpeg.setMaxOutputSize(iMaxMCUs);
   133→            _x = (w > _widthLimit) ? 0 : ((_widthLimit - w) / 2);
   134→            _y = (_heightLimit - h) / 2;
   135→        }
   136→
   137→        if (_useBigEndian) {
   138→            _jpeg.setPixelType(RGB565_BIG_ENDIAN);
   139→        }
   140→
   141→        if (_jpeg.decode(_x, _y, _scale) != 1) {
   142→            _jpeg.close();
   143→            return false;
   144→        }
   145→
   146→        _jpeg.close();
   147→        return true;
   148→    }
   149→

   152→        _buf_read = 0;
   153→        _mjpeg_buf_offset = 0;

   175→MemoryStream::MemoryStream(uint8_t* buffer, size_t size)
   176→    : _buffer(buffer), _size(size), _position(0) {}
   177→
   178→int MemoryStream::available() {
   179→    return _size - _position;
   180→}
   181→
   182→int MemoryStream::read() {
   183→    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position++] : -1;
   184→}
   185→
   186→int MemoryStream::peek() {
   187→    return (_position < _size) ? _buffer[_position] : -1;
   188→}
   189→
   190→size_t MemoryStream::readBytes(char* buffer, size_t length) {
   191→    size_t n = min(length, _size - _position);
   192→    memcpy(buffer, _buffer + _position, n);
   193→    _position += n;
   194→    return n;
   195→}
   196→
   197→void MemoryStream::reset() {
   198→    _position = 0;
   199→}

   264→        return false;

   266→

   268→    _videoBuf = (uint8_t*)ps_malloc(_videoSize);

   270→        f.close();

   275→        free(_videoBuf);

   282→    // Create stream and decoder

   439→void VideoPlayer::_drawTextBox() {
   440→    if (!_display || _currentText.length() == 0) return;
   441→
   442→    // Get actual display dimensions (accounts for rotation)
   443→    int dispWidth = _display->width();
   444→    int dispHeight = _display->height();
   445→
   446→    // Text box dimensions
   447→    const int boxHeight = 80;
   448→    const int boxMargin = 5;
   449→    const int textPadding = 8;
   450→    const int boxY = dispHeight - boxHeight - boxMargin;
   451→
   452→    // Draw semi-transparent background
   453→    _display->fillRect(boxMargin, boxY, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin, boxHeight, TEXT_BG_COLOR);
   454→
   455→    // Draw border
   456→    _display->drawRect(boxMargin, boxY, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin, boxHeight, TEXT_BORDER_COLOR);
   457→    _display->drawRect(boxMargin + 1, boxY + 1, dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin - 2, boxHeight - 2, TEXT_BORDER_COLOR);
   458→
   459→    // Draw text
   460→    _display->setTextColor(TEXT_COLOR);
   461→    _display->setTextSize(2);
   462→    _display->setTextWrap(true);
   463→
   464→    // Calculate text position
   465→    int textX = boxMargin + textPadding;
   466→    int textY = boxY + textPadding;
   467→
   468→    _display->setCursor(textX, textY);
   469→
   470→    // Word wrap manually for better control
   471→    String remaining = _currentText;
   472→    int lineWidth = dispWidth - 2 * boxMargin - 2 * textPadding;
   473→    int charWidth = 12;  // Approximate width per char at size 2
   474→    int charsPerLine = lineWidth / charWidth;
   475→    int lineHeight = 20;
   476→    int maxLines = (boxHeight - 2 * textPadding) / lineHeight;
   477→
   478→    int line = 0;
   479→    while (remaining.length() > 0 && line < maxLines) {
   480→        String lineToPrint;
   481→        if (remaining.length() <= charsPerLine) {
   482→            lineToPrint = remaining;
   483→            remaining = "";
   484→        } else {
   485→            // Find last space before limit
   486→            int breakPoint = charsPerLine;
   487→            while (breakPoint > 0 && remaining[breakPoint] != ' ') {
   488→                breakPoint--;
   489→            }
   490→            if (breakPoint == 0) breakPoint = charsPerLine;
   491→
   492→            lineToPrint = remaining.substring(0, breakPoint);
   493→            remaining = remaining.substring(breakPoint);
   494→            remaining.trim();
   495→        }
   496→
   497→        _display->setCursor(textX, textY + line * lineHeight);
   498→        _display->print(lineToPrint);
   499→        line++;
   500→    }
   501→}

     2→ * OAISYS Badge - Orientation Manager Implementation
     3→ ******************************************************************************/
     4→
     5→#include "orientation.h"
     6→#include "../../config.h"
     7→
     8→#include <Wire.h>

    10→
    11→// Static constants
    12→const float OrientationManager::THRESHOLD = 0.5f;
    13→const unsigned long OrientationManager::DEBOUNCE_MS = ORIENTATION_DEBOUNCE_MS;
    14→const unsigned long OrientationManager::POLL_MS = ORIENTATION_POLL_MS;
    15→
    16→// IMU instance and data
    17→static QMI8658 imu;
    18→static calData calibration = {0};
    19→static AccelData accelData;
    20→
    21→OrientationManager::OrientationManager()
    22→    : _currentRotation(1)
    23→    , _pendingRotation(0)
    24→    , _debounceStart(0)
    25→    , _lastPoll(0)
    26→    , _rotationChanged(false)
    27→    , _imuAvailable(false)
    28→{
    29→}
    30→
    31→bool OrientationManager::begin() {
    32→    Wire.begin(I2C_SDA, I2C_SCL);
    33→
    34→    int err = imu.init(calibration, IMU_ADDRESS);
    35→    _imuAvailable = (err == 0);
    36→
    37→    return _imuAvailable;
    38→}
    39→
    40→void OrientationManager::update() {
    41→    if (!_imuAvailable) return;
    42→
    43→    unsigned long now = millis();
    44→    if (now - _lastPoll < POLL_MS) return;
    45→    _lastPoll = now;
    46→
    47→    // Read accelerometer
    48→    imu.update();
    49→    imu.getAccel(&accelData);
    50→    float accelY = accelData.accelY;
    51→
    52→    // Determine desired rotation based on accelY
    53→    uint8_t desiredRotation = 0;
    54→    if (accelY > THRESHOLD) {
    55→        desiredRotation = 1;  // USB on right (normal)
    56→    } else if (accelY < -THRESHOLD) {
    57→        desiredRotation = 3;  // USB on left (180 flip)
    58→    } else {
    59→        desiredRotation = _currentRotation;  // Hysteresis zone - keep current
    60→    }
    61→
    62→    // State machine logic
    63→    if (desiredRotation == _currentRotation) {
    64→        // Orientation matches current stable state
    65→        _pendingRotation = 0;  // Cancel any pending transition
    66→    } else if (_pendingRotation == 0) {
    67→        // Start new transition
    68→        _pendingRotation = desiredRotation;
    69→        _debounceStart = now;
    70→    } else if (_pendingRotation == desiredRotation) {
    71→        // Transition in progress, check if debounce time elapsed
    72→        if (now - _debounceStart >= DEBOUNCE_MS) {
    73→            // Commit rotation change
    74→            _currentRotation = _pendingRotation;
    75→            _pendingRotation = 0;
    76→            _rotationChanged = true;
    77→        }
    78→    } else {
    79→        // Desired rotation changed during debounce - restart
    80→        _pendingRotation = desiredRotation;
    81→        _debounceStart = now;
    82→    }
    83→}
    84→
    85→bool OrientationManager::hasChanged() {
    86→    if (_rotationChanged) {
    87→        _rotationChanged = false;
    88→        return true;
    89→    }
    90→    return false;
    91→}

    89→bool MicStream::_initI2S() {

    99→        .use_apll = false,
   100→        .tx_desc_auto_clear = false,

   104→    i2s_pin_config_t pins = {

   122→    Serial.println("MicStream: Quick mic warm-up (500ms)...");
   123→    const int QUICK_WARMUP_SAMPLES = SAMPLE_RATE / 2;  // 500ms at 16kHz
   124→    int samplesDiscarded = 0;
   125→    size_t bytes_read;
   126→    while (samplesDiscarded < QUICK_WARMUP_SAMPLES) {
   127→        if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, _i2sBuffer, 512 * 4, &bytes_read, 10) == ESP_OK) {
   128→            samplesDiscarded += bytes_read / 4;
   129→        }
   130→    }
   131→    Serial.println("MicStream: Warm-up done");
   132→
   133→    return true;
   134→}

   138→    int samplesDiscarded = 0;
   139→    size_t bytes_read;
   140→
   141→    unsigned long startTime = millis();
   142→
   143→    while (samplesDiscarded < WARMUP_SAMPLES) {
   144→        if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, _i2sBuffer, 512 * 4, &bytes_read, 10) == ESP_OK) {

   161→    frontend_config.noise_reduction.odd_smoothing = 0.06f;
   162→    frontend_config.noise_reduction.min_signal_remaining = 0.05f;
   163→    frontend_config.pcan_gain_control.enable_pcan = 1;
   164→    frontend_config.pcan_gain_control.strength = 0.95f;
   165→    frontend_config.pcan_gain_control.offset = 80.0f;
   166→    frontend_config.pcan_gain_control.gain_bits = 21;
   167→    frontend_config.log_scale.enable_log = 1;

   169→
   170→    return FrontendPopulateState(&frontend_config, _frontendState, SAMPLE_RATE);
   171→}
   172→
   173→bool MicStream::_captureAudio() {
   174→    int space_available = AUDIO_BUFFER_SIZE - _audioBufferPos;
   175→    if (space_available < 256) {
   176→        return true;  // Buffer full, will process
   177→    }
   178→
   179→    int samples_to_read = min(256, space_available);
   180→    size_t bytes_read;
   181→    if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, _i2sBuffer, samples_to_read * 4, &bytes_read, 10) != ESP_OK) {
   182→        return false;
   183→    }
   184→
   185→    int samples = bytes_read / 4;
   186→    int32_t max_sample = 0;
   187→
   188→    for (int i = 0; i < samples; i++) {
   189→        // INMP441 sends 24-bit in 32-bit frame, shift down
   190→        int32_t sample = _i2sBuffer[i] >> 14;
   191→        _audioBuffer[_audioBufferPos++] = constrain(sample, -32768, 32767);
   192→        if (abs(sample) > max_sample) max_sample = abs(sample);
   193→    }
   194→
   195→    _amplitude = max_sample;
   196→    return true;
   197→}
   198→
   199→bool MicStream::update() {
   200→    if (!_running) return false;
   201→
   202→    if (!_captureAudio()) {
   203→        return false;
   204→    }
   205→
   206→    bool newFrame = false;
   207→
   208→    // Process audio through frontend when we have enough samples
   209→    while (_audioBufferPos >= FEATURE_STRIDE_SAMPLES) {
   210→        size_t num_samples_read;
   211→        FrontendOutput frontend_output = FrontendProcessSamples(
   212→            _frontendState, _audioBuffer, _audioBufferPos, &num_samples_read);
   213→
   214→        if (num_samples_read == 0) {
   215→            break;
   216→        }
   217→
   218→        // Shift remaining samples to start of buffer
   219→        if (num_samples_read < (size_t)_audioBufferPos) {
   220→            memmove(_audioBuffer, _audioBuffer + num_samples_read,
   221→                    (_audioBufferPos - num_samples_read) * sizeof(int16_t));
   222→        }
   223→        _audioBufferPos -= num_samples_read;
   224→
   225→        // If we got features, add to feature buffer
   226→        if (frontend_output.size == FEATURE_BINS) {
   227→            // Shift feature frames if buffer is full
   228→            if (_featureFrameCount >= FEATURE_FRAMES) {
   229→                memmove(_featureBuffer, _featureBuffer + FEATURE_BINS,
   230→                        (FEATURE_FRAMES - 1) * FEATURE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t));
   231→                _featureFrameCount = FEATURE_FRAMES - 1;
   232→            }
   233→
   234→            // Add new frame
   235→            memcpy(_featureBuffer + _featureFrameCount * FEATURE_BINS,
   236→                   frontend_output.values, FEATURE_BINS * sizeof(uint16_t));
   237→            _featureFrameCount++;
   238→
   239→            // Signal that we have a complete feature set
   240→            if (_featureFrameCount >= FEATURE_FRAMES) {
   241→                newFrame = true;
   242→            }
   243→        }
   244→    }
   245→
   246→    return newFrame;
   247→}
   248→
   249→int MicStream::getNewSamples(int16_t* buffer, size_t maxSamples) {
   250→    // This provides raw audio for recording purposes
   251→    // For now, return what's in buffer (caller should copy before next update)
   252→    int count = min((size_t)_audioBufferPos, maxSamples);
   253→    if (count > 0 && buffer) {
   254→        memcpy(buffer, _audioBuffer, count * sizeof(int16_t));
   255→    }
   256→    return count;
   257→}

    36→    _i2sBuffer = (int32_t*)malloc(512 * sizeof(int32_t));
    37→    if (!_i2sBuffer) {
    38→        free(_buffer);
    39→        _buffer = nullptr;
    40→        return false;
    41→    }
    42→
    43→    // Note: I2S is initialized by MicStream, we share the same I2S port
    44→    // This recorder should be used AFTER MicStream.end() is called
    45→
    46→    _initialized = true;
    47→    _sampleCount = 0;
    48→    return true;
    49→}
    50→
    51→void AudioRecorder::end() {
    52→    stopRecording();
    53→
    54→    if (_buffer) {
    55→        free(_buffer);
    56→        _buffer = nullptr;
    57→    }
    58→    if (_i2sBuffer) {
    59→        free(_i2sBuffer);
    60→        _i2sBuffer = nullptr;
    61→    }
    62→
    63→    _initialized = false;
    64→}
    65→
    66→void AudioRecorder::startRecording(float durationSec) {
    67→    if (!_initialized || _recording) return;
    68→
    69→    // Clamp duration
    70→    if (durationSec > RECORDING_MAX_SECONDS) {
    71→        durationSec = RECORDING_MAX_SECONDS;
    72→    }
    73→
    74→    _targetSamples = (size_t)(durationSec * RECORDING_SAMPLE_RATE);
    75→    _sampleCount = 0;
    76→    _recording = true;
    77→
    78→    // Initialize I2S for recording
    79→    i2s_config_t i2s_config = {
    80→        .mode = (i2s_mode_t)(I2S_MODE_MASTER | I2S_MODE_RX),
    81→        .sample_rate = RECORDING_SAMPLE_RATE,
    82→        .bits_per_sample = I2S_BITS_PER_SAMPLE_32BIT,
    83→        .channel_format = I2S_CHANNEL_FMT_ONLY_LEFT,
    84→        .communication_format = I2S_COMM_FORMAT_STAND_I2S,
    85→        .intr_alloc_flags = ESP_INTR_FLAG_LEVEL1,
    86→        .dma_buf_count = 4,
    87→        .dma_buf_len = 256,
    88→        .use_apll = false,
    89→        .tx_desc_auto_clear = false,
    90→        .fixed_mclk = 0
    91→    };
    92→
    93→    i2s_pin_config_t pins = {
    94→        .bck_io_num = MIC_BCK,
    95→        .ws_io_num = MIC_WS,
    96→        .data_out_num = I2S_PIN_NO_CHANGE,
    97→        .data_in_num = MIC_DIN
    98→    };
    99→
   100→    if (i2s_driver_install(I2S_NUM_0, &i2s_config, 0, NULL) != ESP_OK) {
   101→        _recording = false;
   102→        return;
   103→    }
   104→    i2s_set_pin(I2S_NUM_0, &pins);
   105→
   106→    // INMP441 microphone needs warm-up time after I2S init
   107→    // Discard first 2 seconds of audio (junk/noise from mic stabilization)
   108→    Serial.println("AudioRecorder: Mic warm-up (discarding 2s)...");
   109→    _warmUpMic();
   110→
   111→    Serial.printf("AudioRecorder: Started %.1fs recording\n", durationSec);
   112→}
   113→
   114→void AudioRecorder::stopRecording() {
   115→    if (_recording) {
   116→        i2s_driver_uninstall(I2S_NUM_0);
   117→        _recording = false;
   118→        Serial.printf("AudioRecorder: Stopped, %d samples (%.2fs)\n",
   119→                      _sampleCount, getDurationSec());
   120→    }
   121→}
   122→
   123→bool AudioRecorder::_captureChunk() {
   124→    size_t remaining = _targetSamples - _sampleCount;
   125→    if (remaining == 0) return true;  // Done
   126→
   127→    int samples_to_read = min((size_t)256, remaining);
   128→    size_t bytes_read;
   129→
   130→    if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, _i2sBuffer, samples_to_read * 4, &bytes_read, 10) != ESP_OK) {
   131→        return false;
   132→    }
   133→
   134→    int samples = bytes_read / 4;
   135→
   136→    for (int i = 0; i < samples && _sampleCount < _targetSamples; i++) {
   137→        // INMP441 sends 24-bit in 32-bit frame
   138→        int32_t sample = _i2sBuffer[i] >> 14;
   139→        _buffer[_sampleCount++] = constrain(sample, -32768, 32767);
   140→    }
   141→
   142→    return true;
   143→}
   144→
   145→void AudioRecorder::_warmUpMic() {
   146→    // INMP441 needs ~100-200ms minimum to stabilize, but for best results
   147→    // we discard 2 full seconds of audio data
   148→    // At 16kHz, that's 32000 samples = 128KB of data to discard
   149→
   150→    const int WARMUP_SAMPLES = RECORDING_SAMPLE_RATE * 2;  // 2 seconds
   151→    int samplesDiscarded = 0;
   152→    size_t bytes_read;
   153→
   154→    unsigned long startTime = millis();
   155→
   156→    while (samplesDiscarded < WARMUP_SAMPLES) {
   157→        // Read and discard
   158→        if (i2s_read(I2S_NUM_0, _i2sBuffer, 512 * 4, &bytes_read, 10) == ESP_OK) {
   159→            samplesDiscarded += bytes_read / 4;
   160→        }
   161→    }
   162→
   163→    Serial.printf("AudioRecorder: Warm-up done (%d ms, %d samples discarded)\n",
   164→                  (int)(millis() - startTime), samplesDiscarded);
   165→}
   166→
   167→bool AudioRecorder::update() {
   168→    if (!_recording) return false;
   169→
   170→    _captureChunk();
   171→
   172→    // Check if recording complete
   173→    if (_sampleCount >= _targetSamples) {
   174→        stopRecording();
   175→        return true;  // Recording complete
   176→    }
   177→
   178→    return false;  // Still recording
   179→}
   180→
   181→float AudioRecorder::getProgress() const {
   182→    if (_targetSamples == 0) return 0.0f;
   183→    return (float)_sampleCount / _targetSamples;
   184→}
   185→
   186→bool AudioRecorder::saveToSD(const char* filepath) {
   187→    if (!_buffer || _sampleCount == 0) {
   188→        Serial.println("AudioRecorder: No recording to save");
   189→        return false;
   190→    }
   191→
   192→    File file = SD.open(filepath, FILE_WRITE);
   193→    if (!file) {
   194→        Serial.printf("AudioRecorder: Failed to create %s\n", filepath);
   195→        return false;
   196→    }
   197→
   198→    // Write WAV header
   199→    uint32_t dataSize = _sampleCount * sizeof(int16_t);
   200→    uint32_t fileSize = 36 + dataSize;
   201→
   202→    // RIFF header
   203→    file.write((const uint8_t*)"RIFF", 4);
   204→    file.write((uint8_t*)&fileSize, 4);
   205→    file.write((const uint8_t*)"WAVE", 4);
   206→
   207→    // fmt chunk
   208→    file.write((const uint8_t*)"fmt ", 4);
   209→    uint32_t fmtSize = 16;
   210→    file.write((uint8_t*)&fmtSize, 4);
   211→    uint16_t audioFormat = 1;  // PCM
   212→    file.write((uint8_t*)&audioFormat, 2);
   213→    uint16_t numChannels = 1;  // Mono
   214→    file.write((uint8_t*)&numChannels, 2);
   215→    uint32_t sampleRate = RECORDING_SAMPLE_RATE;
   216→    file.write((uint8_t*)&sampleRate, 4);
   217→    uint32_t byteRate = sampleRate * numChannels * sizeof(int16_t);
   218→    file.write((uint8_t*)&byteRate, 4);
   219→    uint16_t blockAlign = numChannels * sizeof(int16_t);
   220→    file.write((uint8_t*)&blockAlign, 2);
   221→    uint16_t bitsPerSample = 16;
   222→    file.write((uint8_t*)&bitsPerSample, 2);
   223→
   224→    // data chunk
   225→    file.write((const uint8_t*)"data", 4);
   226→    file.write((uint8_t*)&dataSize, 4);
   227→    file.write((uint8_t*)_buffer, dataSize);
   228→
   229→    file.close();
   230→
   231→    Serial.printf("AudioRecorder: Saved %s (%d samples, %.2fs)\n",
   232→                  filepath, _sampleCount, getDurationSec());
   233→    return true;
   234→}

    52→bool WakeWordDetector::begin(uint8_t* pool, size_t poolSize,
    53→                              const char* modelPath, const char* configPath) {
    54→    if (_loaded) return true;
    55→
    56→    // Check pool size
    57→    if (poolSize < TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE + VAR_ARENA_SIZE) {
    58→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Pool too small");
    59→        return false;
    60→    }
    61→
    62→    // Assign pool regions
    63→    _tensorArena = pool;
    64→    _varArena = pool + TENSOR_ARENA_SIZE;
    65→
    66→    // Load config (optional - uses defaults if fails)
    67→    if (configPath) {
    68→        _loadConfig(configPath);
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    // Load model from SD
    72→    if (!_loadModel(modelPath)) {
    73→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Model load failed");
    74→        return false;
    75→    }
    76→
    77→    // Initialize TFLite interpreter
    78→    if (!_initInterpreter()) {
    79→        Serial.println("WakeWord: Interpreter init failed");
    80→        if (_modelData) {
    81→            free(_modelData);
    82→            _modelData = nullptr;
    83→        }
    84→        return false;
    85→    }
    86→
    87→    _resetWindow();
    88→    _loaded = true;
    89→    // Start with extended cooldown (3 sec) to let mic stabilize and avoid false triggers
    90→    _lastDetectionMs = millis() + 1500;  // Extra 1.5s beyond normal cooldown
    91→
    92→    Serial.printf("WakeWord: Loaded \"%s\" (%.1fKB model)\n",
    93→                  _config.wake_word, _modelSize / 1024.0f);
    94→    return true;
    95→}

   115→bool WakeWordDetector::_loadConfig(const char* path) {
   116→    File f = SD.open(path);
   117→    if (!f) {
   118→        return false;
   119→    }
   120→
   121→    StaticJsonDocument<512> doc;
   122→    DeserializationError error = deserializeJson(doc, f);
   123→    f.close();
   124→
   125→    if (error) {
   126→        return false;
   127→    }
   128→
   129→    // Load wake word name
   130→    const char* wake_word = doc["wake_word"] | "Hey Daisy";
   131→    strncpy(_config.wake_word, wake_word, sizeof(_config.wake_word) - 1);
   132→    _config.wake_word[sizeof(_config.wake_word) - 1] = '\0';
   133→
   134→    // Load detection parameters from "micro" object
   135→    JsonObject micro = doc["micro"];
   136→    if (micro) {
   137→        _config.probability_cutoff = micro["probability_cutoff"] | 0.5f;
   138→        _config.sliding_window_size = micro["sliding_window_average_size"] | 10;
   139→        _config.min_high_frames = micro["min_high_frames"] | 6;
   140→        _config.min_frame_prob = micro["min_frame_prob"] | 0.5f;
   141→        _config.cooldown_ms = micro["cooldown_ms"] | 1500;
   142→    }
   143→
   144→    // Clamp sliding window size
   145→    if (_config.sliding_window_size > MAX_SLIDING_WINDOW) {
   146→        _config.sliding_window_size = MAX_SLIDING_WINDOW;
   147→    }
   148→
   149→    return true;
   150→}
